result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with a clear header, search, category chips, promo banner, and carousels. The main visual defect is a missing restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, which shows a broken-image placeholder. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional and were not reported.

issues.description: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' fails to load and shows a broken-image placeholder icon on a flat gray box, so the featured card looks empty and unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL and asset pipeline, add a fallback food image or branded placeholder with a proper background, and handle image load errors gracefully.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the first 'Popular right now' card is a gray circle with a white icon. It has weak contrast against the gray placeholder background and is hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a darker or semi-opaque backdrop, or a subtle shadow, so it stands out consistently over both light and dark imagery.
